# meow-rules 0.22.0

Vendored from the exact crates.io 0.22.0 package without a version change.
Upstream: https://github.com/meow-rs/meow-rs . MIT license retained in LICENSE.

Paws adds a typed borrowed geosite-category visitor that reuses the existing
protobuf reader and domain parser. It lets engine adapters compile the same
resource into their native matcher without constructing a Meow runtime or
performing network IO. Existing Meow loaders retain their original behavior.
